_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: two Bowrings, translator recorded per title. Sir John Bowring (1792-1872): Chamisso's Peter Schlemihl (1824) and Translations from Alexander Petőfi (1866, added in round 110). His son Edgar Alfred Bowring (1826-1911): Goethe's Poems in the original metres (1853) and Heine's Poems, complete (1859). PD. Added 2026-10-03 by lane C (round 7) under the coordinator's standing instruction; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst. Round 37 gap-fill: Sir John's Specimens of the Russian Poets (2 vols, 1821-1823), Servian Popular Poetry (1827) and the 1920 Anthology of Jugoslav Poetry built mostly on his versions. Round 92 gap-fill: Edgar Alfred Bowring's Tragedies of Alfieri (1876, 2 vols).
